messages.subject: Re: java.rmi.UnmarshalException with eclipse & statET & keras
messages.body_plain:
Hi Fernando,

I guess R crashes when you run your R script?

You should check:
  - the output of the R process, see "Error Log Console"
    http://www.walware.de/?page=/it/statet/troubleshooting.html
  - look for a file named hs_err_pid* which is generated when the process
    crashes

Regards,
Stephan
